get.description:
Returns provisioning, configured compute, replication, cleanup lifecycle and supported capabilities, including when individual dependencies are unavailable. Enabled Warehouse state is independent of the selected table count. Readiness is inferred from configuration and replication; query connectivity is not checked. Does not inspect the FDW. Observation timestamps are retrieval times, separate from table sync lag, pipeline apply lag and feedback age. Read access remains available without a replication entitlement; mutation endpoints enforce their own entitlements and permissions.

This endpoint is currently in its **Alpha** stage.

compute.description: Configured Warehouse compute and region, which may differ from the source database region. Live availability and capacity are not reported.

observed_at.description: Time the API retrieved this information. This timestamp does not indicate when data was measured or last synchronized.

Null means Postgres reported no value; lag times also become null shortly after a caught-up slot sees no new WAL, while flush_lag_bytes, the WAL not yet confirmed flushed, reads 0. Feedback age measures time since the last response and does not establish how current query results are.

get.description:
Returns the public Arrow Flight SQL endpoint resolved from the project's Warehouse routing, with TLS required on port 443. Status is configured availability and query connectivity is not checked, so DNS readiness does not prove a query will succeed. Login uses a role in the source project database with that role's existing password (postgres uses the project database password), including when the catalog and storage are in another project. The role needs supabase_warehouse_reader membership, which is separate from Management API authorization. No passwords, tokens, catalog credentials or private endpoints are returned, and endpoint, host and port are null unless status is available or pending. Example client: usql -W 'flightsql://postgres@<host>:443?tls=enabled'.

This endpoint is currently in its **Alpha** stage.

get.description:
Lists the source tables selected for Warehouse replication with their replication status and freshness, from the same observations as the Warehouse status. Freshness comes from the replication slot that carries each table: its own sync slot until it follows changes, then the pipeline apply slot; one slot never stands in for the other. lag_ms is that slot's flush lag. Postgres reports no lag time for a caught-up slot without new WAL, so lag_ms can be null while replication_feedback.flush_lag_bytes is 0; neither is ever filled with zero when unknown. observed_at is when the API read the replication state, not when data last synchronized. A stopped, failed or unreadable pipeline reports its tables as stopped or unknown rather than live, and keeps each table's last recorded state. Returns an empty list when Warehouse is not set up, its publication is missing, or it is being disabled or failed to clean up.

This endpoint is currently in its **Alpha** stage.

503.description: Warehouse feature, project metadata or table selection unavailable

$comment: The Warehouse tables listing contract is not yet in the deployed Management API specification.

lag_ms.description: Flush lag in milliseconds that Postgres reports for the slot in replication_feedback. Null when there is no feedback or Postgres reports no recent measurement, which includes a caught-up slot without new WAL; replication_feedback.flush_lag_bytes reads 0 in that case.

observed_at.description: Time the API retrieved the replication state of the table. It does not indicate when data was last synchronized.

replication_feedback.description: Postgres feedback from the replication slot named in source. Null when no feedback is available, including while the pipeline is stopped. Feedback age measures time since the slot last responded and does not establish how current query results are.

source.description: Replication slot that reported the feedback: the table's own sync slot until it follows changes, or the pipeline apply slot once it does.

replication_state.description: Last replication state the pipeline recorded for the table, also while the pipeline is stopped. Null when none was observed.

schema.description: Source PostgreSQL schema of the table.

status.description: Replication status. error means the table failed to replicate; stopped means the pipeline is stopped, stopping or failed, so the table receives no changes; live means the table follows changes; syncing means it is queued, copying or catching up; unknown means the pipeline status or the table state was not observed, for example before replication starts.

warehouse_name.description: Quoted, fully qualified name of the replicated table in the Warehouse.

id.description: Source PostgreSQL table OID, as returned by the Warehouse tables list.

$comment: The Warehouse tables listing contract is not yet in the deployed Management API specification.
